resolved.title: Javascript中的注释
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]JavaScript Comments[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 
Great stuff! You’ll soon be a variable master. 

Ok, let’s talk about [b]comments[/b] in JavaScript.
So we know about statements, these are the instructions within our program that get "executed" when the program runs. 
But! Not all JavaScript statements are "executed".
Any code after a double slash //, or between /* and */, is treated as a [b]comment[/b], and will be ignored, and not executed.

To write a [b]Single line[/b] comment we use double slashes. Like this:
[code format="js" codeId="645"][b]// This is a single line comment[/b]
   alert("This is an alert box!"); [/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2737" width="100%"]
But why write code that is never going to be executed. Isn’t that a waste of time? 
Not at all! Comments are a good idea, especially ones relating to large functions, as they help make our code more readable for others. So be kind, and comment!
[note][b]Heads up![/b]
[b]alert()[/b] is used to create a message box.[/note]

学习完了变量，我相信你很快在运用Javascript变量上游刃有余！

接下来，让我们来谈谈JavaScript中的**注释**。
Javascript中的语句，既是程序中的指令，在程序运行时被 "执行"。

但是，并不是所有的JavaScript语句都会被 "执行"。
任何在双斜线`//`之后的代码，或者在`/*`和`*/`之间的代码，都被视为**注释**，这些注释会被忽略，不会被执行。

我们在代码编码阶段，为什么要去写那些永远不会被执行的代码呢？这不是在浪费时间吗？

从真正的项目实践角度来说，一点也不浪费时间！因为在代码中编写注释是一个很好的习惯。

尤其是与大型函数有关的注释，因为它们有助于使我们的代码对其他人来说更有可读性。所以，请善待自己，为复杂代码编写好注释吧！

resolved.title: 多行注释
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Multiple-Line Comments[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

What if we have more to say?

If we want to create a [b]multi-line comment[/b], we write it between /*and */ 
[s0l0!-header][b]Like this:[/b][/s0l0!-header]
[code format="js" codeId="4816"]/* This code 
   creates an 
   alert box */
   alert("This is an alert box!"); [/code]
[note][b]Heads up![/b]
We use comments to describe and explain what the code is doing.[/note]
